task.description: Independently validate the REQ-227 design artefact (lib/letflow/design/req227-entity-record-payload-validation.md) against REQ-227's full docs/requirements.yaml entry: AC coverage, absence of literal code, resolution of the named namespace open question, accuracy of reuse claims against actual source files, and scope-boundary confirmations.

result.note: All 7 checks pass. (1) All 7 ACs traced to specific sections in §9's traceability table (AC7 correctly flagged as not a design-time concern rather than silently dropped). (2) Grepped the doc for defmodule/def-with-args/schema-do patterns -- zero matches; every fenced block is @type/@spec/a precondition map-literal shown explicitly as 'not executable code' (§4.2) or a JSON-Schema-shaped map illustration -- no real function body anywhere. (3) The namespace open design question (§5.1) is explicitly resolved as option (a) (call Letflow.EventStore.Registry.JsonSchema as-is, no extraction) with 4 numbered rationale points, not left implicit. (4) Verified lib/letflow/event_store/registry/validation_failure.ex directly: %ValidationFailure{field_path, constraint, actual} struct exists exactly as the design describes, with @derive Jason.Encoder and the documented constraint-name vocabulary -- reuse claim is real, not fabricated. (5) Verified lib/letflow/entities/definition.ex's field_def() directly against §2.1/§4.1's mapping table: the 8-atom field_type() union matches exactly; enum_values/required/decimal_precision/decimal_scale fields match; cross-checked definition/validator.ex Rule 6 (enum_values non-empty iff type==:enum) and Rule 7 (decimal_precision/decimal_scale bound digit count at authoring time, not a record-value range) -- confirms the design's finding that no minimum/maximum/maxLength keyword has a corresponding field_def() attribute to translate from; no fabricated or missing constraint kind found. (6) §1 and §7 explicitly confirm no route/controller and no second JSON-Schema engine, matching REQ-227's stated scope boundary; git diff --stat framing given for both. (7) Module naming (Letflow.Entities.Record.Validator) justified in §6 against actual, verified REQ-225 precedent (Letflow.Entities.Definition.Validator / .Shape, read directly at lib/letflow/entities/definition/validator.ex and shape.ex) and the cross-namespace precedent claims (Letflow.Definitions.JsonSchemaShape's moduledoc naming JsonSchema.validate/2 as its shape target, and Letflow.Repository.Attachments' cross-reach into Letflow.Repository.upsert_content/6) were both verified directly against the cited files and are accurate, not fabricated.
